nodes.name: Fetch Tweets with Images
nodes.notes: Walks X /2/users/:id/tweets up to 10 pages, stops as soon as the target tweet is found. Emits one row per matching tweet, each carrying its image URLs, the artist nickname, and the resolved WP user id.

nodes.name: Process Tweet
nodes.notes: Per tweet: upload each image to WP, create a draft comic with the first image as featured media, then set source_tweet_id, source_url, and ceo_html_below_comic via the /comic-easel/v1/comics/{id}/meta endpoint.
